verseText: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
meaning: Because of Adam's sin all people die, but through Jesus Christ those who belong to him will have forever life.

recall.question: Who makes sinful people alive (give them eternal life)?

meaning.question: Adam was the first man, and his sin brought death. What does Jesus bring to those who believe?

application.prompt: Death can feel scary or sad. But remember: Jesus defeated death! How can Jesus' promise of life forever give you hope?
